claims.claim: Real b=1 and 0<h<1 imply J=h and 0<J<1
claims.assumptions: Real height 0<h<1; equal lateral stretches b=1; J=b*b*h.
claims.limitations: No equilibrium, constitutive stress, floating-point refinement or anatomical claim.

claims.assumptions: Real reference volume V>=0 and bulk coefficient K>=0; any real J.
claims.limitations: Only the bulk term is covered; fractional-power shear and derivatives remain unfinished.
claims.implementation: web/material-response.mjs: bulkEnergyJ via the unchanged tissue law.

claims.claim: Real V>0, K>0 imply bulk energy zero iff J=1
claims.assumptions: Real V>0 and K>0; any real J.
claims.limitations: Does not assert loaded equilibrium has J=1, or establish incompressibility.
claims.implementation: web/material-response.mjs: finite bulk energy and volume ratio.

claims.claim: Real positive gap and assumed Rg=0 imply R=0
claims.assumptions: Real reaction R and gap g>0 with assumed complementarity R*g=0.
claims.limitations: Complementarity is assumed, not certified for the numerical wall solve or collisions.
claims.implementation: web/material-response.mjs: unilateral wall reaction and gap.

claims.claim: Real lateral stress and wall work factor as 2V(Px+R)delta
claims.assumptions: Real reference volume, nominal stress, wall reaction and lateral variation; stress/energy derivative association supplied separately.
claims.limitations: No derivative, root existence, uniqueness or stationarity certificate.
claims.implementation: web/material-response.mjs: signed lateral residual and virtual work.
